sections.text:
Toothache; temporarily relieved by holding
ice-water in the mouth. [Mangan. opposite.] Hasty
eating and drinking. Delicate taste.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Excessive hunger. Intolerance of tight
clothing. After wine and liquor.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too early and long lasting. Dys-
menorrhoea, large clots of black blood. Hypersensihve
vulva and vagina. Voluptuous itching.

sections.text:
Wakeful ; on a constant move. Slccp.s till 3
A. M., after which only dozing. Wakes with a start,
sleep disturbed by dreams. Sleepless, on account men-
tal activity; flow of ideas, with nervous excitability.
Disturbed by itching of anus.

sections.label: Respiratory

Short, dry cough of measles in nerv-
ous, delicate children.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Violent irregular palpitation especially after
excessive joy or surprise. Rapid high ten.sioii pulse
and urinary suppression.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Crural neuralgia; worse, motion, af-
ternoon and night; better, by pressure.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, excessive emotions (joy), nar-
cotics, strong odors, noise, open air, told, night. Better,
warmth, from lying down; holding ice in mouth.

included.
